title: Four Dogs Survey Showdown
shortDescription: Four Dogs Survey Showdown at Charter 803 Bar & Grill on November 12 at 6:30 PM.
description: Survey says it's game night at Charter 803 Bar & Grill. Bring a team for Four Dogs Survey Showdown, an interactive trivia-style competition where your group tries to guess the most popular answers to entertaining survey questions. No special trivia expertise needed, just your best guesses and a few friends.
instructions: Free entry. Survey Showdown starts at 6:30 PM. Contact Charter 803 for seating details. Food and drinks are purchased separately.
